onboarding.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme

passages.text: Eligible elderly individuals aged 65 and above, whose names are on the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list, receive monthly financial assistance under the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme.

From the central government: ₹200 per month for eligible elderly individuals aged 65 to 79 years. ₹500 per month for eligible elderly individuals aged 80 years and above. From the state government under the Shravanbal Seva State Pension Scheme: ₹1300 per month for eligible elderly individuals aged 65 to 79 years. ₹1000 per month for eligible elderly individuals aged 80 years and above.
passages.locator: Scheme page; Nature of Benefits section

passages.text: The applicant can apply at the Collector’s Office / Tehsildar’s Office, Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana Branch / Talathi Office.
